title: Balance Games
shortDescription: Visitors stand on a balance board and steer the game with their body: tilt to roll a ball through a maze, keep a line steady, or beat the clock, a playful test of focus and control.
longDescription: A family of games controlled by balance. Players stand on a board, and every shift of their weight moves the game on screen: a ball rolls through a maze, a line has to be held level, or a target must be reached before time runs out. The challenge feels physical and satisfying, from gentle and calm to fast and competitive, which makes it a natural fit for health and wellness campaigns as well as sport and fun activations. Boards, games, difficulty, and visuals are configurable, and the screen can range from a tablet to a large display. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Your Body Is the Controller
highlights.description: No buttons, no instructions: step on the board and lean. The connection between movement and screen is instant, so everyone understands it at first try.

highlights.title: Made for Health and Wellness
highlights.description: Balance and body control are an easy story for insurers, health brands, and workplace programmes, and the game turns that message into something people feel.

highlights.title: Compact and Mobile
highlights.description: A board and a screen are enough, so it fits a booth, a reception area, or a corporate health day without special space or installation.

highlights.title: Harder, Faster, Together
highlights.description: Add a timed maze, levels that get steeper, a two-board duel, a calm mode for wellness breaks, or a version where the whole crowd tilts their phones to steer a giant maze on a big screen.

highlights.title: Balance in Any Story
highlights.description: Roll a ball through a stadium maze for a sports sponsor, keep a surfboard steady for a summer edition, guide a heart through the body for a health campaign, or balance on a frozen lake in winter.

highlights.title: Proof of Movement
highlights.description: Add a data layer that records plays, completion times, and best scores, and pair it with an opt-in step so a health campaign can follow up with participants.

highlights.title: Part of the Active Zone
highlights.description: Pair with Reaction Games and Pose Games for a full movement circuit, with Live Feed to show the best times, or with Visitor Identificator to save each player's score across stations.
